metadata.description: A phased workflow system for Claude Code: converse, plan, execute, finalize. One branch per plan, on a branch or inside a git worktree.

plugins.name: wf
plugins.description: Phased development workflow with natural conversation planning, one phase per session, one branch and one commit per phase, and a self-correcting autonomous chain (convergence loops + fresh-eyes repair)

plugins.name: wf-bar
plugins.description: A button above the prompt that launches the phased workflow's next step — /wf:execute-phase with the phase, its model and effort — read from the plan on disk. A Claude Code mod: needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later, and the wf plugin.
